newsitem.title: USA: Wal-Mart Nov same-store sales up 4 pct.
newsitem.headline: Wal-Mart Nov same-store sales up 4 pct.

text.p: NOTE: Figures in millions except percentage.
Full company name is Wal-Mart Stores Inc

NOTE: Sam's Clubs sales for the four week period were $1.7 billion, up 9.5 percent from $1.6 billion in the similar prior year period. Club sales for the 43 weeks of $16 billion were up three percent over the similar prior year period. Same-club sales up 9.0 percent in four week period and up 2.4 percent year to date.
Sales for the four week period in 1996 included one post Thanksgiving shopping day while sales in the similar period in 1995 included eight holiday shopping days.
